actual_Boolean_family: All NPN transformations of every Boolean table through n=3; all two-bit outers composed with ordered pairs of four explicit balanced three-bit inner functions; stopped physical trees on those compositions; fixed A021 remainder parameters
symmetry: No search symmetry reduction; explicitly test all signed permutations and output signs on all n<=3 tables. The all-n NPN theorem is proved analytically, not inferred from these tests.
arithmetic: Direct integer character sums, exact rational raw masses and prime-log coefficient vectors; rational natural-log intervals from a 32-term atanh series with proved remainder; rational factorial-series bounds for e; exact signed endpoint interval arithmetic.
pilot: Run phases separately in the frozen order; each phase persists final results immediately, uses a 55-second guard, and does not increase dimension.
